1: paraṁ bhūyaḥ pravakṣhyāmi jñānānāṁ jñānam uttamam |
yaj jñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṁ siddhim ito gatāḥ ||
2: idaṁ jñānam upāśhritya mama sādharmyam āgatāḥ |
sarge ’pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti cha ||
3: mama yonir mahad brahma tasmin garbhaṁ dadhāmy aham |
4: tāsāṁ brahma mahad yonir ahaṁ bīja-pradaḥ pitā ||
5: sattvaṁ rajas tama iti guṇāḥ prakṛiti-sambhavāḥ |
8: tamas tv ajñāna-jaṁ viddhi mohanaṁ sarva-dehinām |
9: sattvaṁ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata |
jñānam āvṛitya tu tamaḥ pramāde sañjayaty uta ||
10: rajas tamaśh chābhibhūya sattvaṁ bhavati bhārata |
rajaḥ sattvaṁ tamaśh chaiva tamaḥ sattvaṁ rajas tathā ||
11: jñānaṁ yadā tadā vidyād vivṛiddhaṁ sattvam ity uta ||
12: lobhaḥ pravṛittir ārambhaḥ karmaṇām aśhamaḥ spṛihā |
13: aprakāśho ’pravṛittiśh cha pramādo moha eva cha |
14: yadā sattve pravṛiddhe tu pralayaṁ yāti deha-bhṛit |
16: rajasas tu phalaṁ duḥkham ajñānaṁ tamasaḥ phalam ||
17: sattvāt sañjāyate jñānaṁ rajaso lobha eva cha |
18: ūrdhvaṁ gachchhanti sattva-sthā madhye tiṣhṭhanti rājasāḥ |
19: guṇebhyaśh cha paraṁ vetti mad-bhāvaṁ so ’dhigachchhati ||
20: guṇān etān atītya trīn dehī deha-samudbhavān |
21: kair liṅgais trīn guṇān etān atīto bhavati prabho |
kim āchāraḥ kathaṁ chaitāns trīn guṇān ativartate ||
22: prakāśhaṁ cha pravṛittiṁ cha moham eva cha pāṇḍava |
na dveṣhṭi sampravṛittāni na nivṛittāni kāṅkṣhati ||
23: udāsīna-vad āsīno guṇair yo na vichālyate |
guṇā vartanta ity evaṁ yo ’vatiṣhṭhati neṅgate ||
